The '''Tarc domain''', also known as the '''Tarc territories''', was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==Description==
The Tarc domain consisted of about twenty [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> It contained the arid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hjaff]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Tarc]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Tarc were the only [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species within it.<ref name="AE" />

The Tarc domain served as a large buffer zone between the isolationist Tarc and the other species. The boundary of their domain was formed by twelve systems, four of which contained military outposts.<ref name="AE" />

The Tarc domain was guarded by the [[Ivlacav Gourn]], a [[Navy/Legends|navy]] with a policy of zero tolerance for intruders. The Tarc attacked anyone who dared to enter what they viewed as their "domain of sovereignty." During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], this policy led to a number of [[Tarc—Imperial conflict|skirmishes]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], when Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] tried to cross their borders.<ref name="AE" />

The Tarc were also forbidden from leaving their domain. Those who were caught trying were publicly executed as soon as possible, and no trial was required. Only top military officials and [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] had access to [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped [[Starship/Legends|spacecrafts]], which were used only in special circumstances.<ref name="AE" />
